Treats These Ailments

Conditions listed as treatable by this remedy:

  • Parasitic Infections
    Intestinal parasitic infections causing digestive distress and nutrient malabsorption.
  • Histamine Intolerance
    Inability to properly break down histamine leading to allergy-like symptoms.
  • Digestive Discomfort
    General digestive discomfort including bloating, gas, and indigestion.
  • Gallbladder Disease
    Impaired gallbladder function including gallstones and bile duct obstruction.
